release_scope: Deploy the dependency-free read-only remote MCP endpoint at /api/mcp/insureit-assistant. It authenticates with the existing server-only INSUREIT_ASSISTANT_API_KEY, exposes get_policy_document, and returns only policy-copy metadata plus short-lived five-minute Supabase signed URLs. The policy-documents bucket remains private. No database migration, RLS change, package dependency, or unrelated functionality is included.
